recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If OO later decides to move Task terminology management to UTG/THO, that should be handled as a separate terminology migration rather than by changing this already-applied core source issue.
issue_request: FHIR-50258 was Applied/Persuasive for R6 and asked OO to add Task.code code data-request plus Task input/output parameter codes data-query, data-code, and data-value to support data retrieval tasks.
initial_application: The issue was applied before this reconciliation by dc832849de3734ec7f2cb804f6c0d095ea35bf47, linked from Jira PR #3655, which added data-request to source/task/codesystem-task-code.xml and data-query, data-code, and data-value to source/task/codesystem-task-inputoutput-parameter-type.xml.
additional_context: Task is an active resource in source/fhir.ini, and Task.code, Task.input.type, and Task.output.type bind to value sets backed by the inspected Task code systems. Later Applied issue FHIR-56060 made a non-substantive TitleCase display-name cleanup for the same concepts, explaining why current displays differ in capitalization from the original FHIR-50258 resolution text. OO minutes on 2025-08-26 record the same motion and 7-0-2 vote. Searches found no separate UTG migration issue or community record that changes the core-source conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the requested codes and definitions are already present in active Task terminology source, and the only observed wording differences are display capitalization changes from a later applied cleanup.
